text: abort() (and an expiring timeoutMs) terminates a run parked on an unanswered user_input_request whose consumer handler never resolves: the outstanding request is answered cancel, the stream yields AdapterAbortError or AdapterTimeoutError, and no SDK subprocess is left running.
